text: 53-year-old male. The patient has a 3-week history of fatigue, difficulty to concentrate, and dyspnea on exertion. He also experiences dizziness and digital pain that improves with cold. He has a long history of smoking.

speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Polycythemia Vera.

The patient's history of digital pain improving with cold (likely digital ischemia or erythromelalgia) combined with fatigue, dyspnea, and a long smoking history is highly suggestive of a myeloproliferative neoplasm. I need to confirm this with blood work immediately. REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, peripheral blood smear, and JAK2 V617F mutation analysis.
